title: Generate deterministic QR geometry
description: Select an offline QR encoder and convert validated payloads into deterministic application-owned scene geometry at supported physical sizes.
acceptanceCriteria: The selected QR library and redistribution license are documented
Validated payload, error-correction setting, quiet zone, and physical size produce real QR modules
Equivalent normalized inputs produce identical QR scene geometry
Unsupported payload length or size returns a QR-node-specific diagnostic
Generated fixtures decode to the original payload at every declared supported size

steps.details: Choose and document a browser-compatible offline QR encoder whose output can be normalized into application-owned module data.
Bound payload bytes and physical sizing, define quiet-zone and error-correction defaults, and reject combinations that cannot produce readable integral modules.
Convert the encoder matrix into stable millimetre path or rectangle nodes without persisting library objects or illustrative placeholders.
Compare repeated normalized geometry and decode generated fixtures with an independent decoder for supported and refused boundary cases.

technicalNotes: Limit this ten-minute increment to one encoder adapter, one geometry form, and small boundary fixtures.
QR decode tests establish digital symbol correctness, not successful physical scanning after printing.
